technique_name: Explain why buying local products is beneficial.
description: Buying locally produced goods and services can be beneficial to the local economy. By purchasing local products, more money is kept in the local community, which can stimulate economic growth. Additionally, local businesses are more likely to source their supplies from nearby suppliers, helping to reduce pollution and transportation costs.
